scope: One tabletop only, including its existing sloped banks and short approach/exit blend. R02 triple and R03 table-single are unchanged.
method: Matched colour and tangent normals from a deterministic virtual-relief field; no height-field or collision changes. Reuse existing 8K macro atlases and 4K photographic soil; add one 2K periodic clod colour/normal pair for millimetre close-up detail. Two scoped visual layers retain 4 m cosmetic depths. Preserve all existing HMF layers and shaders.
reference: Thunder Hollow MX screenshots: irregular furrows, clods, compact crests, churned landings and lighter pushed-up side banks. Screenshots do not establish that author's implementation.
